items.title: SD-098 read-time goal-ness: ghost-goal-bank re-ranking under a mid-episode destination shift with reversal
items.note: USER DECISION 2026-09-17 (Orchestrator decision lane orchestrate-20260917-1532): falsify SD-098 against the EXISTING ghost-goal bank; do NOT build SD-097 typed topology, and no stored-node-type comparison arm. A-B-A reversal (phase A at D1, B at D2, C returns to D1 in RETURN / stays at D2 in STAY); DV = AUC(older group A beats newer group B) over rank gains within the A-union-B subset, under the phase-C cue. Recency/displacement predicts AUC<=0.5 in BOTH arms; SD-098 predicts group A is reinstated when the destination returns -- non-monotone in write time, which is what makes it attributable. DV-symmetry: the manipulation changes goal_match by snapshot-dependent, NON-uniform amounts (delta range 0.46 vs mean_abs 0.05), so the rank DV is not invariant under it; STAY is the scored control, not scoped out. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the cross-cue rank-order change over ONE pool; checked V3-EXQ-868 (substrate_hash 6cb1cdca30a9..., PASS, paired ghost_priority at a SINGLE cue across TWO agents), 496, 823, 807 -- none records a second cue over the same pool nor per-anchor provenance, so not recoverable -> run. red-team pass 1 (opus): BLOCKING on a superseded forward-only design (cue displacement collinear with content change; sham shared 4/6 cells with baseline) -- design replaced, not patched. red-team pass 2 (opus): CONTESTED, all 7 findings dispositioned in-source: F1 dv_headroom floor raised 0.03->0.10 so it cannot sit below the criterion it protects; F2 consistency clause recorded as pinned when RETURN saturates; F3 gate swapped from cue_return (circular with the DV) to ENV-level phase-C occupancy; F4/F6a asymmetry + group-size diagnostics surfaced; F6b DV now ranked within A-union-B so group-C cannot crowd either group (this moved the STAY control onto the exact 0.500 null); F7 stale threshold text fixed. F5 ACCEPTED NOT FIXED and recorded as a scope limit: because the policy seeks the destination, destination privilege is NOT separated from sensory-context reinstatement -- the separating condition is measurably too weak to run (paired cue_return +0.003, 4/7). SCOPE: tests SD-098 half (i) only (re-classification with no write, asserted per cell by payload fingerprint); half (ii) needs the stored-node-type arm, deliberately not built. A PASS is PARTIAL support and does NOT close SD-098. Substrate gate: SD-082 (corrupting, e3_selector.py) is OPEN -- driver uses a scripted policy, never calls select_action, asserted per cell (e3_never_entered). top_k uncapped (default 32 truncated the A/B groups away). Tuning seeds 0-6, EVAL seeds 102-116 disjoint (100/101 observed in readiness checks and excluded); tuning: AUC_stay ~0.50 (the recency null), AUC_return ~0.99, contrast +0.470 sd 0.019, 7/7 positive.
